text:
You can move your current account, direct debits, and standing orders to Monzo using the UK's Current Account Switch Service (CASS). It takes 7 working days, is completely free, and is backed by a guarantee that covers any fees or interest if something goes wrong.

Before you start, make sure you have already opened a Monzo current account, have your old bank's card and account details handy, and have no pending transactions or active disputes on your old account.

1
Start the switch in the Monzo app
Takes about 5 minutes

Open the Monzo app, tap Home (or your profile/settings menu), and select Switch to Monzo. You will be prompted to enter your old bank's sort code, account number, and the last 5 digits of your old debit card.

2
Choose full or partial switch
Select Full Switch to automatically move everything and close your old account

Pick a Full Switch if you want Monzo to move your balance, direct debits, standing orders, and salary payments, and automatically close your old account. Pick a Partial Switch if you want to keep your old account open and choose which payments to move (note: partial switches aren't covered by the 7-day guarantee).

3
Pick your switch completion date

Choose a working day at least 7 working days in the future. Monzo will confirm the exact timeline in the app once your old bank approves the request.

4
Let the switch run automatically
Do not set up new direct debits on your old account during this week

Keep using your old card as normal during the 7 working days. Monzo and your old bank will handle moving your direct debits and notifying your employers or bill providers of your new details.

5
Complete the switch

On your chosen switch date, your remaining balance transfers to Monzo, your old account closes (for a full switch), and any stray payments sent to your old details are automatically redirected to Monzo for at least 3 years.

A few things to keep in mind:

Continuous Payment Authorities (CPAs): Subscriptions tied to your long 16-digit debit card number (like Netflix, Spotify, or gym memberships) do not move automatically. Update your card details directly with those companies once your Monzo card arrives.

Overdrafts: If you have an overdraft with your old bank, you will need to pay it off or arrange a repayment plan with them before a full switch can complete.

Statements: Download any old bank statements or tax certificates you might need before the switch date, as you will lose online access to your old account once it closes.
